purpose.zh: 把胯活动开，腿往外打开、转起来更顺
purpose.en: Loosens your hips so your leg opens out and turns more easily.

text.zh: 膝盖抬到跟胯一样高，往外画一圈放下
text.en: Knee up to hip height, circle it out, then down

text.zh: 一手扶椅背，肚脐和胸口一直朝前。
text.en: One hand on the chair. Belly button and chest keep facing forward.

text.zh: 画一圈算 1 下，下一下反着画回来。
text.en: One circle counts as one. The next one goes the other way.

commonErrors.zh: 腿一转，身子也跟着转或往一边倒
commonErrors.en: Body turning or tipping with the leg.
Swinging the leg round too fast.

cautions.zh: 胯不舒服就把圈画小点，还疼就停
cautions.en: If your hip feels off, make the circle smaller. Stop if it still hurts.

cautions.zh: 椅子会滑就换把稳的、不带轮子的
cautions.en: If the chair slides, use a sturdy one without wheels.
